description: Discover supported crypto, equity, FX, and metal symbols before using the paid HTTP API. Returns up to 50 catalog matches with asset class, available services, and pricing tier; it is free, read-only, and never returns live prices or starts payment.

asset_class.description: Optional asset-class filter. Use all for the full catalog, crypto for digital assets, equity/equities for catalog-confirmed stock symbols such as AAPLXUSD, fx for currency pairs, or metal for metals.

query.description: Symbol, ticker, asset, or pair to search for, such as BTC, BTC-USD, ETH, AAPL, EURUSD, or XAUUSD.

name: search_pairs
title: Instrument Search
